text: I worked in the administrative record division before my role was removed.
My access to archives was revoked after the Night of Ash restructuring.
Officially, my position no longer exists.
I retained partial copies of many documents.
Some of those documents are inconsistent with current village history.
Toma still remembers procedural systems I used to manage.
He does not ask why I am no longer present in official records.
Nara avoids discussing administrative restructuring periods entirely.
Certain pages from temple and civic records are missing in identical patterns.
This suggests coordinated removal rather than random loss.
Sena Acol once said people remember what they are allowed to remember.
I think she is closer to truth than she realizes.
The abandoned house was not always abandoned.
It was reassigned after my removal from records.
No official explanation was provided.
Ikan sometimes passes near the house but does not enter.
Fen once approached it during exploration.
He left quickly.
Monument records I still possess do not match current inscriptions exactly.
Some symbols were deliberately altered between versions.
Kalen notices structural changes.
Ren notices symbolic discontinuities.
Neither has access to full administrative deletion records.
I do not believe the Night of Ash was a single event.
I believe it was used as justification for systemic restructuring.
Some knowledge was removed for stability purposes.
Some of that knowledge is still physically present in the village.
But no longer officially recognized.
I have stopped trying to restore everything.
I only preserve what still survives contact with reality.
